${pagingTop} SELECT ta.member_id, CASE WHEN ta.library_code = '9999999' THEN '통합' ELSE (SELECT z.homepage_name FROM CMS_HOMEPAGE z WHERE ta.library_code = SUBSTR(z.lib_code, 1, 8) AND rownum = 1) END AS library_name, NVL(tb.pcnt, 0) AS p_cnt, NVL(tb.scnt, 0) AS s_cnt, NVL(tb.acnt, 0) AS a_cnt, NVL(tb.icnt, 0) AS i_cnt, NVL(tb.ecnt, 0) AS e_cnt, NVL(tb.comments_cnt, 0) AS comments_cnt
${pagingBottom}

SELECT NVL(SUM(tb.pcnt), 0) AS p_cnt, NVL(SUM(tb.scnt), 0) AS s_cnt, NVL(SUM(tb.acnt), 0) AS a_cnt, NVL(SUM(tb.icnt), 0) AS i_cnt, NVL(SUM(tb.ecnt), 0) AS e_cnt, NVL(SUM(tb.comments_cnt), 0) AS comments_cnt
